sourceSentences: [0] Nautilus falls off later in the game compared to you, but can still mess you up with his chain CC. Avoid knocking up your allies if he ult's you and as always, dodge Q.
[0] The only reason he can be problematic is because he is generally paired with strong early game ADCs. You do have strong counter-engage into him, and outscale him hard.
[1] Maokai is annoying as he gets on top of you easily and he can CC you very long with his W and Q. However he has no way of getting out easily so you can punish that.
[1] Maokai is really strong currently and he can use his W to dodge your hook and Ult. He will try to roam so try to match him.
[1] Tree man. watch his saplings. Keep an eye on them. Keep an eye on his ult in team fights, become a wall for that to prevent your team from being rooted and then dying.
[1] Skill based matchup. Both champions have amazing engage and disengage, while also being the best tanks in the bot lane.
[2] Be careful not to be grabbed by Nautilus. Keep your distance while you toss saplings, and wait for an opportunity to engage.
[2] If your lane is difficult, focus on roaming to help other lanes.
[3] Although Maokai’s (W) has a short range, making it difficult for him to initiate combat, he has a lot of CC skills that can be used to counterplay.
[3] Maokai’s (P) also restores a lot of health, so engage and retreat wisely. Be careful of AP Maokai’s saplings (E) inside brushes to gain the upper hand in combat.
